LESSON: THE HUMAN BREATHING SYSTEM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 1.2: The Human Breathing System

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Human Breathing System
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What makes up the human breathing system?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the main parts of the human breathing system
2. describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ The Human Breathing System

Teach
• Observe The Human Breathing System in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about The Human Breathing System (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to The Human Breathing System.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for The Human Breathing System.
• Write 5 bullet facts about The Human Breathing System.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify the main parts of the human breathing system
• describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on The Human Breathing System.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for The Human Breathing System: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes up the human breathing system?
2. What enhances a healthy breathing system?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the main parts of the human breathing system
• describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
